h1: Custom 5X Large Fleece for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 5X large fleece jackets with your logo. Perfect for corporate gifts and team uniforms. Shop bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need custom fleece that fits every member of your team, 5X large sizing ensures comfort and professionalism for all body types. Whether you're outfitting safety crews with the Boundary Fleece Jacket or providing branded warmth for a company event, these roomy jackets accept full-color embroidery and screen printing without distortion. Choose from quarter-zip pullovers or full-zip styles in durable polyfleece that holds up to daily wear.
heroAltText: Custom 5X large fleece jacket with embroidered logo, available in bulk for corporate teams
